name: The Lone Gunmen

tenures.role: tag team and stable — Machina and Rudo Insano, with Sid Snow, Billy James and the Total Eclipse in its matches; Tag Team Champions twice, over Heaven's Demons (Wednesday Warfare, 14 October 1998) and over Ultra Cool 2000 (Countdown '99, 30 December 1999)
tenures.source: fWo's own show write-ups (fed 47 in its current holder's backstage database, bookings 4510 to 4849): first at Wednesday Warfare, 15 July 1998 (4517, "Lone Gunmen Interview"); "Rudo and Machina, the Lone Gunmen" (4519 ¶122); the Tag Team changes at 4533 (¶16–17) and 4672 (¶36–37), the second lost to the Underground at Invasion 2000 (4679 ¶378–381); last at Sunday Slaughter, 2 July 2000 (4724 ¶22–31).
tenures.note: 44 shows on the write-ups, 15 July 1998 to 2 July 2000, 19 of them with a match. The Shocker walks with them and stands guard over Sid Snow (4560 ¶10; 4670 ¶525). The team is named again in the story's November 2002: Rudo's later self is "the young boy who was in the Lone Gunmen" (4847 ¶15), and Machina returns "on behalf of the Lone Gunmen" (4848 ¶384).

tenures.role: stable, in the story's later years: brought back together in the federation's August 2004 special, Inbetween: The legend of the Lone Gunmen
tenures.source: fWo's own show write-ups (fed 47 in its current holder's backstage database, booking 5024): Inbetween: The legend of the Lone Gunmen, 1 August 2004 (5024: "Once upon a time there was a group of individuals who called themselves the Lone Gunmen. Led by their masked leader Machina", ¶2; "a little Lone Gunmen reunion", ¶366; "the other Lone Gunmen, who even now are struggling to find and rejoin their once, great friend", ¶441; Sid Snow, the Total Eclipse and Kid Cool after Penny Pureheart's death, and Sid and the Eclipse moving to England with Machina and Rudo's later self, ¶922–925).
tenures.note: The special's own title names the team. Written after Ed Wilson's death in May 2001. Machina, Rudo's later self, Sid Snow, the Total Eclipse and Penny Pureheart are each credited in it on their own records; its replays of the team's old matches credit nobody. The team is recalled again in England at the end of 2005 (5104 ¶366), a narration, not credited.

caption: Machina and Rudo Insano's team from July 1998, joined in its matches by Sid Snow, Billy James and the Total Eclipse, twice the fWo Tag Team Champions — over Heaven's Demons in October 1998 and over Ultra Cool 2000 at Countdown '99 — and brought back together by fWo's staff after Ed Wilson's death in May 2001, in the story's August 2004 special.
